C1_nested_restriction.note: Restriction maps compose (Tr_CD = Tr_C o Tr_D = Tr_D o Tr_C) and nested or overlapping restrictions of ONE global state agree automatically. This is the necessary direction; it is an identity, checked here in both trace orders.

C2_bell_chain.analytic_proof: If rho_AB is pure then any extension satisfies rho_ABC = rho_AB (x) rho_C (purity => no correlations with C), so rho_BC = Tr_A(rho_AB) (x) rho_C = (I/2) (x) rho_C, whose fidelity with Phi+ is Tr(rho_C)/4 = 1/4 != 1. Overlap agreement is necessary, not sufficient (entanglement monogamy).

C3_quantitative_obstruction.note: Linear objective over the convex set of 3-qubit states (SDP). The optimum is strictly below 2: the two requested Bell marginals cannot coexist; the gap is the quantitative size of the obstruction.

C4_werner_thresholds.state_family: isotropic state W(p) = p Phi+ + (1-p) I/4 (U x U* invariant); locally equivalent to the Werner state p Psi- + (1-p) I/4 pairwise, and for the chain globally via Y on B; the triangle problems are distinct but both give 1/3
C4_werner_thresholds.note: W(p) on each listed pair, with identical overlaps by construction. The largest p admitting a common global state is computed by SDP (interior-point value within 1e-8 of 2/3 and 1/3); above it the pairwise-consistent family has no global realization, certified by a strictly positive minimum marginal violation.

C5_classical_contrast.chain_note: Classically, two marginals sharing one variable ALWAYS have a joint (Markov gluing). The quantum Bell chain fails. The obstruction in C2 is specifically quantum (monogamy), not a bookkeeping failure.
C5_classical_contrast.cycle_note: Even classically, overlap agreement on a cycle need not suffice: three pairwise perfectly anticorrelated bits have no joint distribution. The obstruction is an odd number of anticorrelated edges around the cycle, not cyclicity as such: the 4-cycle with four anticorrelated edges extends (1/2 on 0101 and 1/2 on 1010). Overlap agreement suffices for EVERY consistent family exactly on acyclic structures (Vorob'ev 1962); in the quantum case it fails already on a chain.

C6_inconsistent_overlap.note: Disagreeing overlaps are infeasible at once: overlap agreement is the necessary condition every sector's effective environment must satisfy.
